node.title: Conjecture-F prize consumer flat-scope compiler
node.statement: The current strict DAG has exactly one Conjecture-F caller, spi_point_counting. The LIST route-retirement theorem proves that imgfib has no Conjecture-F call and instead exposes two direct L1 residual targets. For every remaining SPI call, the proved Hankel descriptor emits the exact fiber P(ker M(z)) cap D_j(H), with projective dimension, root threshold, unchanged domain, first-owner chronology, and slope-incidence multiplicity preserved. This exhausts current prize consumers. Any new strict caller re-opens the compiler.
node.falsifier: an omitted strict Conjecture-F caller, a current LIST call hidden behind a direct residual, or loss of slope-incidence multiplicity or first-owner chronology in the SPI descriptor
